answer: By the relic of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, capped per identity per epoch, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the ivory until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ridge of the next round.
